title: sort cards into bins
seam: each card still to sort: data-card="<key>" (its word on it), data-selected="true|false" kept current
each bin (the whole bin area is the target): data-bin="<key>" (its name on it)
a sorted card: it shows inside its bin with data-placed="<bin key>"
brief: KIND: game. Sorting things into groups.

BOARD: the bins (Studio.params.bins) side by side, each named; the cards (Studio.params.cards, in that order) laid out above them, each showing its word. Every card looks the same: nothing tells which bin it belongs to.

ACTIVITY: tap a card to pick it up (it lifts / glows), then tap a bin -> Studio.answer({card: <card key>, bin: <bin key>}). On correct the card slides into the bin and stays there. On wrong it shakes gently and returns to its place, unselected. When every card is sorted: the done text and Studio.done().
antiPatterns: cards coloured by their bin before they are sorted
a wrongly sorted card staying in the bin
cards reordered or grouped by answer
